## CHINA — profile (page 143)

- **Header facts:** Region: East Asia & Pacific; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: IBRD; Data status: Preliminary data (P); Population: 1,406.6 million; GNI: 19,384,279; Unit: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 2,277,598, **-4.3% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Printed start and end values are **1,333,769** (2015) and **2,277,598** (2025). The line rises from 2015 through the late 2010s, continues upward to a peak around **2021** at ≈2.7 trillion, then declines in 2022–25, ending below the peak but above all earlier years.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 2,277,598
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed:** 509,812
    - **Private nonguaranteed:** 507,949
    - **Short-term:** 1,259,838
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** 509,812
    - **Multilateral:** 81,128
    - **Bilateral:** 10,692
    - **Private creditors:** 417,992
  - **Multilateral:** 81,128
    - **IMF-SDR allocations:** 49,584
    - **Asian Dev. Bank:** 17,024
    - **Other multilateral:** 14,519
  - **Bilateral:** 10,692
    - **Japan:** 5,105
    - **Multiple lenders:** 4,384
    - **Other bilateral:** 1,203

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**
  - **External debt / exports:** 51%, **-10.0%**. Line rises from 2015 to a peak around **2020** (≈mid-60s%), then declines through 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** 12%, **-8.1%**. Line edges up to a peak around **2020** (≈13%), then trends down gradually to 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** 9%, **+6.9%**. Line trends upward overall from 2015, with fluctuations, peaking around **2022–23** at ≈10%, dipping, then ending slightly higher in 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** 2%, **+9.1%**. Line rises gradually from 2015, peaks around **2022–23** at ≈2%, dips slightly, and ends around 2% in 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **24 yrs**; Grace period **5 yrs**; Interest rate **3.4%**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **10 yrs**; Grace period **2 yrs**; Interest rate **2.8%**

- **Notes:** Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries.
- **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
